raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Roadmap item 1 of [RFC #8324](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues/8324), split from [integration preview #25](https://github.com/ISEEKYAN/verl/pull/25). Centralize bootstrap, engine, construction, per-model MTP and forward compatibility selection in `compat.py`. Each temporary feature records its reason, upstream links and retirement condition. Use per-process/per-model idempotence, retry failed installs, and avoid retaining discarded models.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Searched existing work: [patch PR search](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+megatron+patch), [RFC-linked PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+8324+in%3Abody).
- [x] Title follows the project format.

This consolidates installation boundaries; it does not duplicate #8338's recompute storage fix, #8031's MTP gradient fix, or #8029's parameter readiness fix. Existing replacement implementations remain until their feature slices are reviewed. In particular Core #8673 covers detach only and #8674 covers masked replay; neither alone retires the entire legacy adapter.

### Test

Slurm CPU, Torch 2.13.0+cpu / Core 0.21.0 / Transformers 5.16.1: **18 passed** using `python -m pytest --noconftest --import-mode=importlib -q tests/utils/megatron/test_compat_on_cpu.py tests/utils/test_megatron_mtp_dcp.py tests/utils/test_megatron_router_replay_dcp.py`. Covers native no-op/callable identity, install-once, failure/retry, per-model ownership/GC, later detach enablement, zero-MTP references, bootstrap and forward delegation, plus existing DCP/replay behavior. All-files pre-commit passes. CUDA/NPU/ROCm execution is not claimed.

### API and Usage Example

Engine/model setup uses `apply_engine_patches`, `apply_model_patches`, `apply_construction_patches` and `configure_forward`. Existing `patch_engine_mtp` delegates to the same boundary. Native/affected-version checks run before installers; semantic fixes without a validated retirement boundary remain explicit legacy entries.

### Design & Code Changes

Bootstrap precedes registry imports. Version guards skip obsolete writer/MLA imports on new Core. Optional-extension implementations keep their dependency probes. MTP/replay consumers are intentionally migrated in later roadmap items; merging an upstream PR does not change an installed package or a still-legacy consumer. The only global state tracks installation checks; model ownership uses weak references.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read contribution guide.
- [x] All-files pre-commit.
- [x] Documentation and CPU regressions.
- [ ] Human line review and platform qualification.

Upstream draft of [fork preview #26](https://github.com/ISEEKYAN/verl/pull/26), submitted at the author's request. Human line review and platform qualification remain pending. Prepared with Codex assistance.

+"""Compatibility selection must preserve native methods and per-model ownership."""
+
+import gc
+import inspect
+from weakref import WeakKeyDictionary, ref
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from verl.models.mcore import compat
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def isolated_registry(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(compat, "_checked_global", set())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(compat, "_checked_models", WeakKeyDictionary())
+
+
+def test_native_capability_leaves_callable_untouched():
+    class Provider:
+        def forward(self, *, output_processor=None):
+            return output_processor
+
+    original = Provider.forward
+
+    def forbidden():
+        raise AssertionError("Native capability must bypass compatibility installation")
+
+    assert not compat.install_patch(
+        "mtp_postprocess",
+        forbidden,
+        needed=lambda: "output_processor" not in inspect.signature(Provider.forward).parameters,
+    )
+    assert Provider.forward is original
+
+
+def test_install_once_and_failure_can_retry():
+    attempts = []
+
+    def install():
+        attempts.append(1)
+        if len(attempts) == 1:
+            raise RuntimeError("installation failed")
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="installation failed"):
+        compat.install_patch("recompute", install, needed=lambda: True)
+    assert compat.install_patch("recompute", install, needed=lambda: True)
+    assert not compat.install_patch("recompute", install, needed=lambda: True)
+    assert len(attempts) == 2
+
+
+def test_model_scopes_do_not_retain_models():
+    calls = []
+    first, second = torch.nn.Module(), torch.nn.Module()
+    for model in (first, first, second):
+        compat.install_patch("mtp_postprocess", lambda: calls.append(1), needed=lambda: True, owner=model)
+    assert len(calls) == 2
+    first_ref = ref(first)
+    del first
+    gc.collect()
+    assert first_ref() is None
+    assert len(compat._checked_models) == 1
+
+
+def test_recheck_native_before_installer_cache():
+    checks = []
+    compat.install_patch("mla", lambda: None, needed=lambda: True)
+    assert not compat.install_patch("mla", lambda: None, needed=lambda: checks.append("native") or False)
+    assert checks == ["native"]
+
+
+def test_mtp_setup_is_idempotent_and_can_enable_detach_later(monkeypatch):
+    from verl.models.mcore import mtp_patch
+
+    calls = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mtp_patch, "patch_postprocess", lambda model: calls.append("output"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mtp_patch, "patch_mtp_layer_checkpointed_forward", lambda model: calls.append("checkpoint"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mtp_patch, "patch_mtp_layer_get_embeddings", lambda model: calls.append("embeddings"))
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    compat.apply_model_patches(model, mtp_enabled=True)
+    compat.apply_model_patches(model, mtp_enabled=True, detach_encoder=True)
+    compat.apply_model_patches(model, mtp_enabled=True, detach_encoder=True)
+    assert calls == ["output", "checkpoint", "embeddings"]
+
+
+def test_zero_mtp_reference_only_installs_postprocess(monkeypatch):
+    from verl.models.mcore import mtp_patch
+
+    calls = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mtp_patch, "patch_postprocess", lambda model: calls.append(model))
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    compat.apply_model_patches(model, forward_only=True, mtp_num_layers=0)
+    compat.apply_model_patches(model, forward_only=True, mtp_num_layers=0)
+    assert calls == [model]
+
+
+def test_unaffected_writer_never_imports_legacy_installer(monkeypatch):
+    calls = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(compat, "_legacy", lambda name: lambda: calls.append(name))
+    compat.apply_bootstrap_patches()
+    compat.apply_bootstrap_patches()
+    assert calls == ["neutralize_broken_flash_attn_cute"]
+
+
+def test_unknown_patch_fails_before_mutating():
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+        compat.install_patch("not_registered", lambda: pytest.fail("mutated"), needed=lambda: True)
+
+
+def test_forward_setup_uses_shared_compatibility_boundary(monkeypatch):
+    from verl.models.mcore import model_forward_fused
+
+    calls = []
+    model, model_config, engine_config = object(), object(), object()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        model_forward_fused, "patch_fused_forward", lambda *args, **kwargs: calls.append((args, kwargs))
+    )
+    compat.configure_forward(model, model_config, engine_config=engine_config)
+    assert calls == [((model, model_config), {"engine_config": engine_config})]

+# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+# limitations under the License.
+
+# there is some bug in mcore 0.12, so we need to patch it
+# 1. `get_query_key_value_tensors` in `multi_latent_attention.py` works wrong when packed_seq_params is not None
+
+
+"""Single installation boundary for temporary Megatron compatibility.
+
+Only this module selects patch implementations. Retirement requires both native
+capability and a consumer using that contract, not merely a merged upstream PR.
+"""
+
+import logging
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from threading import RLock
+from weakref import WeakKeyDictionary
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PatchInfo:
+    """Reviewable purpose and removal condition for one compatibility feature."""
+
+    reason: str
+    upstream: tuple[str, ...]
+    retire_when: str
+
+
+PATCHES = {
+    "flash_attn_cute": PatchInfo("Broken optional FA4 import", (), "Installed FA4 imports successfully"),
+    "checkpoint_writer": PatchInfo(
+        "MCore 0.12.1 / Torch 2.8-2.9 writer API", (), "Core or Torch is outside the affected versions"
+    ),
+    "hadamard": PatchInfo(
+        "Optional CUDA extension unavailable on ROCm", (), "Native fast_hadamard_transform imports successfully"
+    ),
+    "mla": PatchInfo("Legacy MLA packed sequence execution", (), "MCore >= 0.16.2"),
+    "router_replay": PatchInfo(
+        "Legacy verl replay consumer",
+        ("https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/8674",),
+        "Consumer migrates to native replay and replay_mask/exact recomputation are validated",
+    ),
+    "mtp_inference": PatchInfo(
+        "Ascend zero-layer MTP compatibility", (), "Native zero-layer inference is validated; no verified boundary yet"
+    ),
+    "recompute": PatchInfo(
+        "MoE checkpoint residual memory",
+        ("https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8338",),
+        "Gradient and MoE memory parity pass; linked verl PR is not a Core fix",
+    ),
+    "fused_forward": PatchInfo(
+        "Provider lacks native output callbacks",
+        ("https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/6933",),
+        "Provider forward exposes output_processor and output_processor_context",
+    ),
+    "mtp_postprocess": PatchInfo(
+        "RL MTP loss, output weight and normalization",
+        ("https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/8673",),
+        "Consumer uses native MTP controls and detach; #8673 covers detach only",
+    ),
+    "mtp_checkpoint": PatchInfo(
+        "MTP checkpoint handling", (), "Native MTP checkpoint path passes supported runtime-CP cases"
+    ),
+    "mtp_embeddings": PatchInfo(
+        "MTP backbone detach and runtime CP",
+        (),
+        "Native backbone detach/runtime CP passes; no complete upstream fix yet",
+    ),
+}
+
+_checked_global = set()
+_checked_models = WeakKeyDictionary()
+_install_lock = RLock()
+
+
+def install_patch(name, install, *, needed, owner=None):
+    """Check necessity first; install at most once per process or model.
+
+    ``needed`` is a callable so native capability is checked before touching the
+    target. An installer may perform its own dependency probe, hence a true
+    return means the compatibility check ran, not necessarily a method changed.
+    Failed installs are not marked complete and can be retried.
+    """
+    info = PATCHES[name]
+    with _install_lock:
+        if not needed():
+            logger.debug("Megatron compatibility %s skipped: %s", name, info.retire_when)
+            return False
+        installed = _checked_global if owner is None else _checked_models.setdefault(owner, set())
+        if name in installed:
+            return False
+        install()
+        installed.add(name)
+        logger.info("Megatron compatibility %s checked: %s; upstream=%s", name, info.reason, info.upstream)
+        return True
+
+
+def _legacy(name):
+    from verl.models.mcore import patch
+
+    return getattr(patch, name)
+
+
+def apply_bootstrap_patches():
+    """Run before registry imports can reach Megatron optional extensions."""
+    install_patch("flash_attn_cute", lambda: _legacy("neutralize_broken_flash_attn_cute")(), needed=lambda: True)
+
+    def writer_affected():
+        import megatron.core
+        import torch
+        from packaging.version import Version
+
+        return Version(megatron.core.__version__).base_version == "0.12.1" and Version(
+            torch.__version__
+        ).base_version in ("2.8.0", "2.9.0")
+
+    install_patch(
+        "checkpoint_writer", lambda: _legacy("apply_patch_megatron_v012_with_torch_v28_v29")(), needed=writer_affected
+    )
+
+
+def apply_construction_patches(config):
+    """Keep legacy MLA behavior while avoiding obsolete implementations on new Core."""
+    import megatron.core
+    from megatron.core.transformer import MLATransformerConfig
+    from packaging.version import Version
+
+    if not isinstance(config, MLATransformerConfig):
+        return
+    install_patch("hadamard", lambda: _legacy("apply_fast_hadamard_transform_shim")(), needed=lambda: True)
+    install_patch(
+        "mla", lambda: _legacy("apply_patch")(), needed=lambda: Version(megatron.core.__version__) < Version("0.16.2")
+    )
+
+
+def apply_engine_patches(*, routing_replay=False):
+    """Install process-wide behavior requested by this engine."""
+    import megatron.core
+    from packaging.version import Version
+
+    from verl.utils.device import is_cuda_available, is_npu_available
+
+    def replay():
+        from verl.utils.megatron.router_replay_patch import apply_router_replay_patch
+
+        apply_router_replay_patch()
+
+    # Native replay cannot replace the legacy driver's registry until slice 4.
+    install_patch("router_replay", replay, needed=lambda: routing_replay)
+    install_patch(
+        "mtp_inference",
+        lambda: _legacy("apply_mtp_inference_patch")(),
+        needed=lambda: is_npu_available and Version(megatron.core.__version__) >= Version("0.16.0"),
+    )
+    # Do not guess a retirement version for the unresolved memory regression.
+    install_patch(
+        "recompute", lambda: _legacy("apply_patch_megatron_recomputation_backward")(), needed=lambda: is_cuda_available
+    )
+
+
+def apply_model_patches(models, *, mtp_enabled=False, detach_encoder=False, forward_only=False, mtp_num_layers=None):
+    """Install only per-model MTP compatibility, without stacking replacements."""
+    from verl.models.mcore import mtp_patch
+
+    for model in models if isinstance(models, list | tuple) else [models]:
+        postprocess = mtp_enabled or (forward_only and mtp_num_layers == 0)
+        install_patch(
+            "mtp_postprocess",
+            lambda model=model: mtp_patch.patch_postprocess(model),
+            needed=lambda postprocess=postprocess: postprocess,
+            owner=model,
+        )
+        install_patch(
+            "mtp_checkpoint",
+            lambda model=model: mtp_patch.patch_mtp_layer_checkpointed_forward(model),
+            needed=lambda: mtp_enabled,
+            owner=model,
+        )
+        install_patch(
+            "mtp_embeddings",
+            lambda model=model: mtp_patch.patch_mtp_layer_get_embeddings(model),
+            needed=lambda: mtp_enabled and detach_encoder,
+            owner=model,
+        )
+
+
+def configure_forward(model, model_config=None, *, engine_config=None):
+    """Select native output hooks or the isolated legacy forward compatibility."""
+    from verl.models.mcore.model_forward_fused import patch_fused_forward
+
+    return patch_fused_forward(model, model_config, engine_config=engine_config)
